== Biography ==
Moses married Mary J. Pierce of Cincinnati on 05-November-1839. They had three children: Lois Ladd, Robert Finley, and John Cameron (died at 5 months). Mary J. Pierce died of consumption on 14-March-1846. The children were cared for by their aunt, Mary Glasgow of Pittsburgh.

Moses later married Martha W. Thompson of Pittsburgh in 1848. Children from this marriage were: Mary J., Clara T. Peninnah T., and William M.

In August 1879 he married a third time, to Mary Cavin of McKeesport, Pennsylvania, 

Many details about Moses and his family are included In a [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow Family] written by [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-590 William Melanchthon Glasgow].
